text: Official Python client (edison-client) installable with pip/uv
quote: uv pip install edison-client

text: API access is authenticated with API keys created under API Tokens on the user's profile page
quote: Authentication is done by providing an API key, which can be obtained directly from your profile page in the Edison platform.

text: Submit tasks programmatically via create_task, which accepts a TaskRequest or dict and returns a task id
quote: you can submit tasks to the platform by calling the `create_task` method, which receives a `TaskRequest` (or a dictionary with `kwargs`) and returns the task id.

text: JobNames enum in the client lists the available agent task types, such as Literature
quote: we have created a JobNames enum that contains the available task types.

text: Submit literature questions in natural language as a task query
Client provides async variants of task creation and retrieval (acreate_task, aget_task)
quote: Asynchronous tasks: get_task(task_id) or aget_task(task_id) and create_task(TaskRequest) or acreate_task(TaskRequest)

text: Plain dicts can be passed anywhere a model like TaskRequest is accepted and are validated automatically
quote: Anywhere a model such as TaskRequest is accepted, you can also pass a plain dict with the same fields — it's validated into the model for you.

text: Run multiple tasks at once and wait for all of them to complete
quote: run_tasks_until_done() Run multiple tasks and wait for them to complete.

text: Submit many jobs and retrieve their results later, asynchronously
quote: Sometimes you may want to submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time. The platform API supports this

text: Pass runtime configuration to the agent and ask follow-up questions about a previous task
quote: we show how to submit and retrieve a task, pass runtime configuration to the agent, and ask follow-up questions to the previous task.

text: High-reasoning Literature mode (LITERATURE_HIGH) for state-of-the-art performance
quote: JobNames.LITERATURE_HIGH ... High reasoning mode enabled for SOTA performance.

text: Upload directories to a data storage service, optionally as a collection
quote: To upload a directory to the data storage service: ... as_collection=True

text: Inspect the generated notebook and artifacts after a task completes
quote: Once the task has completed you may want to check the contents of the notebook or look through the artifacts generated.

text: Long-lived chat sessions that keep the agent's sandbox, workspace files and message history across turns
quote: A chat session is a long-lived conversation with an agent that keeps its sandbox, its workspace files, and its message history across turns.

text: Inject a message into a chat turn that is already running
quote: queue_chat_message(session_id, project_id, message) | Inject a message into a turn already running

text: Recover a chat session after its sandbox has expired
quote: recover_chat_session(session_id, project_id, ...) | Warm a session back up after its sandbox expired

text: Kosmos takes a research objective and datasets, then autonomously reads literature, writes and runs code, generates hypotheses and writes a cited report
quote: Given a research objective and one or more datasets, Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.

text: Kosmos forms and tests hypotheses as part of complete end-to-end research workflows
quote: Kosmos conducts complete research workflows — from reading scientific literature and analyzing data to forming and testing hypotheses and producing comprehensive, citable reports.

text: Every conclusion is auditable and can be traced back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it
quote: Every conclusion is fully auditable. You can trace any finding back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it.

text: Kosmos generates publication-ready figures and data visualizations alongside its written analysis
quote: Kosmos also generates publication-ready figures and data visualizations alongside its written analysis.

text: Literature agent answers complex scientific questions with high-accuracy, cited responses
quote: It accesses 175M+ papers, trials, and patents with native understanding of citation graphs, journal quality, and clinical trial data. You can ask it a complex scientific question and get a high-accuracy, cited response

text: Searches 175M+ papers, clinical trials and patents, with understanding of citation graphs, journal quality and trial data
quote: It accesses 175M+ papers, trials, and patents with native understanding of citation graphs, journal quality, and clinical trial data.

text: Deep literature reviews that synthesize conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers
quote: task it with a deep literature review synthesizing conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers

text: Literature agent supports diagram creation and figure pullouts
quote: Literature also supports diagram creation and figure pullouts.

text: Analysis agent processes complex experimental data such as flow cytometry and RNA-seq into analyses, statistics and publication-ready figures
quote: Analysis specializes in processing complex experimental data, including flow cytometry, RNA-seq, and other biological datasets. It turns raw data into detailed analyses, statistical results, and publication-ready figures.

text: Precedent agent checks whether a research idea has been tried before, assessing novelty and gaps across fields
quote: Precedent determines whether a research idea has been tried before. It searches across fields to assess novelty and identify gaps, helping you avoid duplicating existing work and focus on what's actually new.

text: Molecules is a chemistry-focused agent for molecular design and analysis
quote: Molecules is a chemistry-focused agent for molecular design and analysis.

text: Molecules can produce synthesis routes, molecular property predictions, safety assessments and literature-backed answers
quote: It can be a synthesis route, molecular property prediction, safety assessment, literature-backed answer, or a combination of these.

text: Generous free tier for academics
quote: Edison maintains a generous free tier for academics.

text: Paid plans offer higher rate limits and additional features
quote: Researchers who need higher rate limits or additional features can subscribe to paid plans.
